description: This file defines a Prometheus process metrics collector, including the processCollector struct, options, and functions to create and manage the collector, as well as platform support checks and PID retrieval.

classes.name: processCollector
classes.description: Struct implementing a Prometheus process metrics collector with methods for collection and description.

methods.name: errorCollectFn
methods.description: Handles errors during collection when process metrics are unsupported.

methods.name: errorDescribeFn
methods.description: Handles errors during description when process metrics are unsupported.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Returns current metrics of the process collector.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Returns descriptions of the process collector metrics.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Reports an error as an invalid metric if error reporting is enabled.

methods.name: NewPidFileFn
methods.description: Creates a function to read PID from a specified file.
